{
  "name": "cli-dispatch",
  "version": "7.5.2",
  "description": "Delegate tasks to the right worker CLI — multi-backend delegation hub. Backends: DeepSeek-powered Claude Code (claude-ds), Antigravity / Gemini (agy, ag-agent), OpenAI Codex CLI (codex, cx-agent), OpenCode via OpenRouter (opencode, oc-agent), GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot, cp-agent), and a local Ollama model (ol-agent). Setup-time backend selection, deterministic runner (cli-dispatch-run — worker + verify with zero LLM babysitter tokens), single-command ds/ag/cx/oc/cp/ol-agent, session tracking (live monitoring + resume), read-only mode (Codex only — real OS-level sandbox; OpenCode/Copilot have no sandbox equivalent, isolation is via git worktree only), global MCP isolation, runtime/idle timeout safety net, fully-agentic tasks in isolated worktrees, optional auto-install of missing worker CLIs (`--install-missing`/`-InstallMissing`, opt-in).",
  "author": {
    "name": "rbinar",
    "url": "https://github.com/rbinar"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/rbinar/cli-dispatch",
  "repository": "https://github.com/rbinar/cli-dispatch",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "deepseek_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DeepSeek API key",
      "description": "From platform.deepseek.com, API keys. Needed for the DeepSeek backend.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "openrouter_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenRouter API key",
      "description": "From openrouter.ai/keys. Needed for the OpenCode backend.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "gemini_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Gemini API key (optional)",
      "description": "Only for headless use; normally sign in with agy.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "codex_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Codex API key (optional)",
      "description": "Only for headless use; normally codex login.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "copilot_github_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Copilot GitHub token (optional)",
      "description": "Fine-grained PAT with Copilot Requests; normally gh auth login is reused.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "cli-dispatch",
    "delegation",
    "deepseek",
    "antigravity",
    "gemini",
    "codex",
    "openai",
    "opencode",
    "openrouter",
    "copilot",
    "github-copilot",
    "ollama",
    "local-llm",
    "worker",
    "claude-code"
  ]
}
